source_title: Influence of a father's artwork on the drawings of his children
desc_src: This photo shows the drawings of young Lao girls inspired by the artwork of their father-in-law. The painting on the right is an acrylic work on canva produced in 2006 by French artist Basile Morin , while the marker and pencil drawings on the left are imitations by the adopted daughters who found their inspiration in their father-in-law's paintings. With similar style, shapes and structures, these personal productions show the influence of a parent on young children in the artistic field. The two flags on each side of the colorful wheel are supposed to be Lao flags .
